locators.locator: Abstract paragraph abstract1.1 at local line 225
locators.finding: The paper defines the displayed kc(G) macro as the local clique cover number, based on the maximum number of covering cliques incident to any vertex.

locators.locator: Introduction paragraph S1.p2 and display S1.Ex1 at local lines 240 and 245
locators.finding: The formal definition again identifies kc(G) with a minimum over clique-cover valency, not a random-walk invariant.

reason: Within this paper, kc(G) denotes local clique cover number. It does not denote Kemeny's constant.
